sum: SunCar Technology Group Inc. develops and operates AI cloud-based platforms in the People's Republic of China. Its platforms connect drivers with a range of auto services and insurance coverage options through a network of sales partners. The company's cloud platform empowers its enterprise customers to access, manage, and optimize their auto eInsurance and auto service offerings. It offers insurance intermediation services; technical software and consulting related to automobile services and insurance, such as customer relationship management, order management, finance management, and visual analysis systems; and sells auto service coupons to enterprise customers. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.
